🧮 EstimatOR — Super Tool
4 estimation methods · editable day rates · Specter market research · low/high range · custom build-up
Crew & Schedule
Specter Voss — Market Research
🔮 How this works: Specter Voss reads your project description, applies current 2025-26 Greater Philadelphia / Bucks / Montco / Delco market rates for labor & materials, factors in PA UCC permit fees, AHBCO's standard 5% admin fee, 15-20% overhead, 18% profit, 10% contingency. Returns a fully-broken-down estimate plus market notes.
Low / High Range Analysis
📊 How this works: Generates two estimates for the same project — a budget-conscious LOW (basic materials, fast schedule, no buffer) and a premium HIGH (best materials, careful execution, contingency baked in). Returns the average and a recommended sweet-spot quote you can present to the customer.
Custom Build-Up — Materials · Labor · Equipment · Profit · Overhead
🛠 How this works: Build the price line by line. Plug in your real material cost, calculate labor from a crew or type a flat number, click tools from the Home Depot rental catalog, then choose profit and overhead/contingency as a percentage or a flat dollar amount. Total updates live. Push to invoice as a single total or as itemized lines from the description.

Connect iCloud Account

Migrate your iCloud Photos library into Baza. Work photos auto-route to AHB123, personal media to your Baza Cloud.
Before continuing: Generate an app-specific password at account.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords. Your real Apple ID password will not work.
Two-factor auth: After clicking Connect below, you'll see a CLI command. Run it once in a terminal — Apple will send a 6-digit code to your trusted devices and you'll enter it. From then on the cookie is cached and sync runs unattended.
